bull.b: A materially repaired balance sheet with zero debt and sizable cash/marketable securities provides runway and reduces refinancing risk. bull.t: Live product with operational proof points
bull.b: Having GLDY live with NAV tracking, an attestation process underway and actual dividend distributions demonstrates end-to-end operational capability—issuance, custody, accounting and payouts. bear.b: The company currently generates essentially no GAAP revenue while reporting material operating and net losses. Structural profitability requires sustained, sizable AUM growth and fee capture; absent that trajectory, the business will remain dependent on capital raises and cannot self-fund operating scale.

Consistent negative operating and free cash flow indicates structural cash burn; Q1 used $10.2M of cash. Even with recent fundraising and securities, durability of runway depends on AUM monetization timing. Slower revenue ramp risks needing additional external financing within months.

bear.t: High expense base and equity dilution risk
bear.b: A dramatic step-up in operating costs—largely from stock-based compensation—creates a high fixed cost profile and signals potential dilution. If AUM and revenue scale lag, elevated noncash compensation and ongoing spending will compress future margins and dilute shareholders, challenging long-term return creation.
